title: Recommended tour in Barcelona
text: We had a wonderful experience! The team was extremely attentive, the tour was very well organized, and everything was handled with great professionalism. The guide was knowledgeable and made the tour even more interesting and enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a well-organized experience in Barcelona!
author: orsoblue

title: Martin was a guide...
text: Martin was a very interesting guide. His explanations were clear and you can really tell that he loves this city.
author: Melanie_L

title: Best Tour I ever made!! Thank you Martin
text: The guide made me feel right at home, explained everything, and we even tried turrón! The group was small, so it felt like a personalized experience. For that price, it's absolutely recommended!
author: Artemis987

title: Wonderful experience
text: Aldo our guide was awesome, very knowledgeable in all aspects of the tour. Had great energy even though he had done the tour a few times in another language before our group. He was very considerate of everyone in the group and made sure no one got left behind or left out.
author: Antonio_r

title: Fun interesting tour and new friends!
text:
Excellent explanation of Sagrada Família and Gaudí’s houses, plus delicious local sweets and also as an special extra they gave us sweet wine!! 
Unbeatable tour for the price! The group was very special from different nationalities and we went to dinner, Thanks to our amazing guide!!!
author: Carolina_D

title: This was a great,...
text: This was a great, informative and fun walking tour! Francisco was an amazing guide! He told us interesting details of all the places we visited and showed us how to buy tickets (best value) for the Metro.
author: Tristy_B

title: Great tour for those short on time.
text: This is a great tour for those who only have a short amount of  time to spend in Barcelona. We saw a great mix of new and old, as well as many great photo spots. Riding the metro was a fun experience to add to the tour. Mirto was a wonderful tour guide! She was full of knowledge!
author: Sherry_R

title: Our guide was Super Mario!
text: Our guide, Mario, was very knowledgeable and personable!  We learned so much about Barcelona. It was very hot and Mario made sure that we all stayed hydrated and were as comfortable as possible.
author: Michael_R

title: Lots of great insight...
text: Lots of great insight about the exterior of the Sagrada Familia, as well as great info about the Rambla.
author: Neal_T

title: Perfect
text: Loved this express tour! In just 3 hours, we saw Sagrada Familia, Casa Batlló, Casa Milà, and the Gothic Quarter. Our guide was friendly, knowledgeable, and gave great photo tips. Highly recommend!
author: 174nataliiap
